records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated total revenues in the first quarter of 2022 increased $38.5 million, or 31%, from the first quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Backlog reported by our Offshore/Manufactured Products segment increased to $265 million as of March 31, 2022 from $226 million as of March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our reported results of operations reflect the negative impact of the global response to the COVID-19 pandemic, ongoing uncertainties related to future crude oil demand and supply and, to a lesser extent, supply chain disruptions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The higher commodity price environment was driven by crude oil supply reductions resulting from the Russian invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, increased demand as the global effects of the COVID-19 pandemic have moderated and slower crude oil production growth due to reduced investments by operators globally.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our consolidated operating loss was $4.3 million in the first quarter of 2022.
